# else_null

<!-- Generated by xtask. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Summary:** Removes redundant ELSE NULL branches from CASE expressions.

**Category:** `maintainability`

**Editor default:** `save`

**Default level:** `hint`

**Fixable:** yes

## Rationale

CASE expressions already default to NULL when no ELSE branch is provided.

## Configuration

```toml
[lints]
else_null = { level = "warn" }
```

### Options

No options.

## Examples

**Anti-pattern:**

```sql
CASE WHEN flag THEN 1 ELSE NULL END
```

**Best practice:**

```sql

```
